prompt: Why is the count on the lunch board unreliable for tracking food?
promptZh: 為什麼不能靠午餐板上的數目推算剩餘食物？

options.text: It includes people who have not arrived.
options.whyZh: 板上寫的是已出餐的盤數，沒說列入未到者。

options.text: It was copied from the warming shelf.
options.zh: 數字是從保溫層架抄來的。
options.whyZh: 板上盤數和保溫架小烤盤是不同資訊。

options.text: Two plates can represent only one portion.
options.zh: 兩個盤子有時只代表一份。
options.whyZh: 分裝時同一勺可放進兩盤，所以盤數不是份數。

options.text: It counts how many scoops are left.
options.whyZh: 板上標示的是出餐盤數，不是剩下的勺數。

explanationZh: 分裝時同一勺可放進兩盤，所以盤數不是份數。
evidence: The board says thirty plates served. How much vegetable bake is left? Some diners asked us to split one serving between two plates. | Count portions, not plates. A full scoop is one portion. Those split servings were still one scoop each.
